margin_status: numerical sensitivity values, not business acceptance or real EV service thresholds
target: signed cumulative relative-reference energy debt since request_start, kWh; never clip negative credit
uncertainty: known Gaussian effective difference error covariance; reference random errors would require all covariance/cross terms; marginal sigma and AR rho are declared inputs, not estimated from these curves
bias: known absolute bound on difference bias times absolute integrated weights; unknown unbounded bias has no guaranteed interval
endpoint: fixed predeclared deadline interval using z(1-alpha/2)
path: post-release endpoints predetermined by grid, K=180; simultaneous bands using z(1-alpha/(2*K)); no assumption of independence of cumulative errors
decision: upper<=epsilon: within_margin; lower>epsilon: above_margin; else unresolved; no missing-to-zero, no exact-zero recovery promise
time_statement: first possible/supported grid endpoint under simultaneous band, never continuous physical time or sustained recovery
comparison: old exact endpoint sign and fixed pointwise 95% endpoint vs new simultaneous path separately; F0 first-crossing retained only as retrospective design context
truth_isolation: estimator only observed reference/power/grid and declared uncertainty; save observed-derived interval arrays before evaluator computes true power/debt; no parameter selection
stress: AR1 with iid assumption and omitted reference bias explicitly misspecified; coverage not promised; truncated deadline and missing interval in constructed checks
raw_root: data/驱动因素解耦模拟数据集_B1_recovery_v1_20261021
budget: 5 observation models x 4 mechanisms x 1000 independent noise draws per cell; variants share external noise for comparisons; no training/tuning/library installation/GPU
exit: report coverage/incorrect decisive calls/unresolved rates and assumptions; no tweaking epsilon after test; preserve old D106 outputs; next independent graph-learning component
